messages.text: At recess tomorrow can I be on your side for tag?
My mom said pajama Friday is maybe winning because so many hands went up.
My mom said I can ask about the playground thing tomorrow. I don't want Maya to sit by the wall again.
Yes. I am making two sides after lunch. You and Jayden can start with me, then we swap after 3 rounds.
I put my hand for extra playground time but pajamas is good too.
I can say she can be on my team. If they say no I will tell Ms. Keene.
What about Nia? She did not know where base was today.
Mrs. Carter said we have to be kind if our pick does not get the most marks.
Ok. My mom said use kind words first.
I will show her the tree base first and say no extra tags when someone is tying shoes.
Yeah like when she read the Dr. King page and said use calm words.
Mom said that too after the TV people were talking loud last night.
Selamawit sent me the picture of your reading page. Did you finish the March calendar box too?
Yes. I did 20 minutes and Mom signed it. I picked the purple sticker.
Good. The big envelopes on the counter are for your mom and dad. Yours is the library book, little sunshine.
Show me the blue fish pages when you call, konjo. Your mom said there is a very long one from the library too.
It has tiny words but I can try 2 pages. The coral picture has orange fish.
Good. Go slowly and point under the words. After that tell me if the boat page is your favorite.
The boat has beds inside. I like that page.
I found three quarters under the Lego table. Want them in your pink pig or should I leave them by the lamp?
Living room blocks are everywhere, but I saved the blue tower. Want me to start the floor race before dinner?
Pink pig please. Also the school paper has boxes I don't know.
Yes and I need the snow queen song first. I can do the big part.
One loud chorus, then shoes in the basket and pillows back on the couch.
Put it in Mom's blue folder. She knows which boxes need grown-up answers.
Ok. Can I still drop the quarters in myself?
Then movie with Mom too? I want the blanket.
Your blue folder says Mrs. Kline's class will meet in Room 14 this morning, not your regular room.
Can you walk with me until the door?
Yes. You can hold my hand in the hallway, and I will wait until you see Aaliyah.
I will stand by you first.
I put the shin pads and water bottle by your backpack for after school.
Can I wear the fast shoes with the blue laces?
Yes, and please save some energy for the tall rope ladder at the park afterward. Love you.
Hi honey, I saw your folder note. Did you find Ms. Rivera before recess ended?
Yes. I told her I was sad when Grace and Mateo ran to the blacktop.
Good job using words. What happened after?
Aaliyah said they thought I was still eating crackers. Then I did hopscotch with her.
At recess tomorrow can you be on my side for freeze tag?
Yes but I have to count the people like Coach Ray showed so it is fair.
Okay then we can do hopscotch after the line gets too long.
I can do that. I liked when he made two sides and I got to say who goes where.
My mom said maybe no blacktop tomorrow if it pours.
At recess tomorrow can we make the ocean girl and the snow dress girl on the big paper?
My mom said I can have one tablet turn after snack. Are you doing the star math one?
I hope the big puddles go away. I want to run to the fence and get the dry leaf by the swings.
Yes. I need turquoise and brown crayons. I want the hair to curl like mine this time.
I have to ask Mom to open it. I want the one with puppies and numbers.
Can you bring the sparkly crayons tomorrow? My mom said ask your mom first.
Mom said yes if I put them right back in my backpack after homework.
Show me your puppy when our moms send pictures later.
Save me one that makes the loud sound when you step on it.
Ok and we can put the pig and chicken by the boat.
Okay. Mom said only the kid folder today.
Ok! Also my puppy chewed my green one. Yours are safer in your room.
And everybody holds hands at the end.
Okay, and if we get the playground I am going first to the slide.
Mine just get lost under Lego. Dad found two by my bed.
I found the big round tray cover. Tell your mom I can bring it Saturday for the bread rolls and the red chicken pot.
Can I help put the soft circles on the tray?
Yes, gentle hands. After dinner I will tell the story about the rainy-season flowers again.
And singing too?
Can I be the one with the clipboard first when I come Saturday?
When I come Saturday can we use the flat green plate first?
Only after my bear and bunny do their names and sit crisscross in the front row.
Yes but I am saving the red and yellow roof pieces for mine.
Fine but I get to ring the little bell before snack time.
Fine. Then after that we can stand by the counter when Auntie mixes the sweet stuff.
Then I will do the camera song and put a bandage on the lion if he falls off his chair.
I want the big spoon turn and the tiny brown chips.
My mom said bring the shiny belt if we play dress-up after church.
I want the white one with the gold bottom because it twirls pretty.
Ok and when Auntie comes in we say selam first, not just hi.
I know. Grandma smiles bigger when I say it right.
I put the culture-night paper back in your blue folder. We picked the injera photo and Grandma's coffee pot picture, okay? ❤️
Can I draw the big airplane too? Because I never went where Grandma talks about.
Yes, draw the airplane as a wish. For the form, I wrote that your first hospital was here in PA and we will check the old papers for the town.
Aaliyah said her table has flags with red and green. Mine has the bread and Grandma's dress.
Your blue folder says tomorrow's assembly has a visitor with a badge talking about crossing streets and calling 911. Please leave the permission slip in your backpack. ❤️
Is it like when the car with lights was at Community Day?
Yes, that kind of visit. Just listening, asking questions, and staying with your class.
I could not think of any cousin or friend story for my question card, so I wrote parade and school.
My mom said our bus picture is blurry but you can see your blue shirt.
I was looking at the tall bones again when she took it.
You kept drawing the spiky one on the ride home.
Tomorrow I have no soccer, so I can finish it after my goggles get packed.
I put the little cup back on the top shelf. The paper from Dr. Reese is still beside it.
Thank you. She is wrapped up with the yellow blanket and sipping the tea slowly.
Want me to start one short episode, or save the bigger screen for all of us after dinner?
Short episode first. Later we can all sit with her if she is still worn out.
Good morning, sweet girl. I put the blue paper in your folder and your water bottle is by the door. Dr. Rosen said we can count to five together if you need it. ❤️
I want you to hold my hand if there is a pinch.
I will. Daddy and I read the note last night, and it is one of the things that helps your class and Grandma stay well.
Can I ask Dr. Rosen and not the computer?
Hi love, did the purple folder come home today?
yes and Ms Carter put a star on my page because I finished all the boxes
Wonderful. Please put the folder on the table and move the clothes from your floor into the basket before snack.
ok I am doing basket first then snack
Finish the two spelling lines before you open the kitten drawing game, okay? Dinner is almost ready. ❤️
Can I color the purple one after I write them?
Yes, after the lines. Then bath before your hair gets too sleepy.
I did the lines. I am showing you.
How did Field 3 go?
She stayed close by my side during sign-in and didn't say much when Coach Riley asked names.
Got it. Did she kick once they started?
Yes, after a few minutes. She joined the line when the kids were doing cone taps.
Can I bring the purple Lego box after church tomorrow?
Yes! Mom said we can build on the rug after Dad moves the coffee table.
My mom said I have to take my bag back home before dinner.
Okay. Then I get my pillow corner back for reading night.
Good morning, sweet girl. I put your swim towel and goggles by the backpack. Nothing else for the nurse table today, just your water bottle. ❤️
I am a little scared because it is the first swim day.
That happens before new things. Do our three slow breaths in the car, then try the first game with the teacher.
Okay. My legs feel ready for kicking fast.
Can we do hopscotch at the park after my mom says yes?
Yes if we make it by the picnic table. My mom can sit there.
Ok not by the parking lines. We can use chalk near the blue slide.
And tell me if you run to the swings first because I look back for Mom.
Selamawit sent me your paper flower with the little verse on the stem. Did you make that this morning?
Yes Grandma, I used purple paper and the sticky jewels. The big singers were clapping so fast today.
I am happy you stayed with the children and used your careful hands. Send me a picture when the glue is dry.
Mom said I can hold it up on video after lunch.
Found two quarters under the couch during cleanup. Want them in the purple pouch or the brick-set page?
Purple pouch. I am still picking between the sparkly ears and the blue dress doll.
Okay. I will tape them in so they don't fall out before the trip.
Can we write the brick set on the birthday paper then?
When you come after church can we play teacher? I want the red marker first.
Only if we make the paper with morning bell, reading, snack, then playground.
Ok but I get to be teacher before snack.
Write it down so we both know turns. I can bring my first-grade folder stickers too.
Mekdes, blue bowl or the sandwich today? We have the round cereal and the bananas are ready.
Sandwich with the banana circles please.
Okay. I put apple slices in the side pocket too. Water bottle is by your folder. ❤️
Can I have the orange dip cup for carrots after school?
Sweet girl, I saw the picture your mom held up yesterday. Was that Moana with the turtle?
Yes and Hana said the turtle needed a school bag.
Next time bring the one with the yellow castle. Auntie Roman asked me about it after coffee.
Mom said I can show it if the screen is not too wiggly.
Can you bring the pink goggles Saturday? I want to try them on after the cousins game.
Mom says they stay in my blue bag with the towel so I do not lose them.
Fine. Then bring the shin things too if we play in Auntie's yard.
They are by my sneakers. I have to remember both bags.
My mom said maybe playdate Friday. Do you have your tablet there?
Yes but after dinner. Mom uses it for the recipe first.
Can we play in your room or the kitchen table?
Kitchen table after Dad clears his work cords. Mom said snack bowls for us two.
Did you bring the fish book home? My mom said the big blue place is really far.
Yes. I read the page with the map. It says Australia at the bottom.
Can you read me the hard page on tablet later? I want to see the giant shell.
Maybe after dinner. I need Mom for some words.
My mom said I can text. Tomorrow I want hopscotch first.
Ok. If Grace draws by the wall and Mateo does soccer, can I still ask you?
Yes. Just ask can I play. I can tell them you are done snack.
I will ask before I make my mad face.
My mom said yes for Saturday. I want the first turn kicking at the orange cones.
Okay but after that we do the chase game to the big tree.
And then monkey bars. I can skip two bars now.
I can try three if my hands are not cold.
Is my sweet girl resting now? I prayed for her this afternoon.
Yes, she is on the couch with soup and her water bottle. She asked for the purple blanket.
Good. Let Mama handle the little cup if the number goes up again, and let her watch the bright animal show.
I will. She smiled when the theme song started.
Selamawit sent me the photo from the big building in DC. Show me your drawing on video, my sweet girl.
I made the long neck and the teeth. I used gray and brown.
Beautiful. Are you resting tonight after all these school papers and new swim days?
Mom put the towel by my backpack because the old practice days are done.
I saw the tiny bandage on your arm when I got home. You still up for finishing the Lego roof after dinner?
Yes. I did not like the ouch part but Mom squeezed my hand.
That sounds brave enough to me. Dr. Rosen and Nurse Kelly both said you listened carefully.
Nurse Kelly said ask a grown-up before clicking on pages about body stuff.
My mom said if we practice the clapping song, we get first turn with the little drums next time.
Only if you do not take all the white roll pieces from my side.
Fine, but I get the egg from the red sauce if the grown-ups let us taste.
I will ask Mom. We can be teachers after the story part.
At pretend school can I be teacher first? You were teacher last time.
Ok but if somebody says Zara can't play we stop and make a new rule.
Fine. My auntie said grown-ups were talking again when the TV was on.
Mom said the big part is everybody gets to be safe. Then we turned it off.
When I come Saturday I want teacher game first.
After practice I can show you how to make two teams with counting.
Then we can run from the porch to the tree and back.
Okay and if it is warm we can do chalk squares too.
Can I be teacher first on Sunday?
You can do morning chart first. I do reading group after. Then Aaliyah can pick a desk job if she comes.
When we play teacher Saturday I get to pick the book first.
No we can make tally lines like my class and the most lines picks.
Ok but auntie said no yelling if mine loses.
But last time you picked the blocks.
Can we play Ms Carter and line up the stuffed animals when I come Saturday?
This time we use the spinner, no peeking, and new kids get to hear how the game works before we start.
yes but you have to raise your hand and listen when I read the weather chart
My Sunday teacher says listen first then talk nice.
Only if you let me be first after. Bring the little blocks too.
I can after I pick them up from the floor because Dad said no stepping on pieces
They moved recess to the gym if the rain stays. Please keep your sneakers on, love.
But the gym is too loud. Can I bring my leaf bag in my backpack for after school?
One small paper bag is fine. We can look by the apartment path if the sidewalk dries.
I want the ones that snap, not the soft muddy ones.
Dinner first, then you may go back to the den shelf for ten minutes. Please keep the colored roof pieces off the floor.
Can my roof be all the colors again?
Yes, after plates are cleared. I also saved one clean spoon for tomorrow's bowl.
And not only little chips. A bigger sprinkle.
My mom said the game at recess changed. We might do tag by the big slide.
Who is counting and how long is one turn?
I can count to 20. Then you pick hopscotch or tag.
Ok. I like two picks. Tell me at lunch before we go out.
Show me your school board on video, little one. Did you draw the tall white church from my old photo?
Yes and I drew me on this side because I have not gone there for real.
One day. For now put the blue coffee cups and the yellow dress picture. Your mama said the teacher asked for where you first came home from the hospital.
Mom said PA but she has to look for the town name.
Show me the new paper on video, sweetheart. Your mom said there is a girl standing by water.
I made her not scared. She has big curly hair and she is holding the paddle.
I see the curls. Very nice. Is that a little animal beside her?
Yes and then I made a snow castle page too but the blue crayon got tiny.
I found the photo from last summer's parade where you waved at the motorcycle and then asked for the sticker.
Can I use that for my community helper page?
Sure. Your examples can be the parade, the school talk, and the car parked by the library picnic.
I asked if we had a family story but I only knew those ones.
Bring your tiny money holder Sunday. I want to hear the clink.
It has dimes and the card cash from Grandma. Mom said don't open the bottom plug at church.
My mom said we have to let aunties do the table papers anyway.
Good because I only know my name part.
Can you come after church Sunday and run teacher game with me? I want to be the principal first.
Yes but I get teacher after you. I was sad at recess today but I am not sad now.
Then we can make a line for Lego school and race to the couch.
I can race. Mom said bring sneakers, not church shoes.
Can we make the Lego school have a bunny room when I come Saturday?
Yes but pretend only. Mom said tiny pieces stay on the table and not by the couch.
I will be the teacher first this time.
Okay but Dad said after dinner we clean up before story time.
I put the little flag-color bracelet in your backpack for sharing circle.
Can I tell them Grandma says selam on video?
Yes, and you can show the picture of you in the white dress from New Year lunch.
That picture is pretty. My skirt was big like a princess one.
I put the index cards back in your purple box. Please leave a path to the closet before bedtime. ❤️
The puppy still has not finished quiet reading and the giraffe is waiting for his sticker.
Two more cards, then pajamas. You can keep the toy stethoscope on the desk for tomorrow.
Can I use the phone stand too? I need to say good morning friends before the weather picture.
My mom said the mall has those mouse headbands today.
I can't get one now. Mine is for when we go to the castle place.
You could wear it at recess after you get it.
Maybe. I put it on my little paper with the singing snowman thing too.
Selamawit sent me the form for the June pool group. Did Mekdes choose morning or afternoon, dear?
Morning. I want to go before it gets too hot.
Good. Keep your towel folded nicely and listen to the coach.
I am going to try to make it across and not stop so much.
Selamawit, did she finish the blue castle drawing on the tablet? I want to see it after lunch.
Grandma I colored the roof purple. Mom can send it when she is done folding.
Good job, my sweet girl. Do your reading game first and then I will watch the little video you like with you on call.
Mom said timer first. I will show you with her phone.
Send me her cupcake picture when the candles are ready. I want to hear the children at the table.
I am putting sprinkles. Hana said I get first song because I helped stir.
Good girl. After everyone eats, show Grandma your drawing and sing the part you practiced.
I will do it loud but not by your knees.
I rinsed the red berries. Want to press the blender button after Lego cleanup?
I'm by the library lot. Hold my hand at Old William Penn; cars are moving quick there today.
Yes and put banana too, not just red ones.
Can you stand at the gate when I climb?
Yes. I'll be at the gate, then we can do the big slide before snack.
Deal. Peanut butter is staying for your sandwich later, so I only used milk and ice.
Save me the cup with the yellow straw.
I picked the ladder that faces you.
I put the tablet on the charger. Ask Mom before you start the penguin math game.
She said after I put the workbook in my folder.
Good. Pick one game, then pajamas and I will read the dragon book.
The short dragon one please.
My mom said the party is at Sky Zone and we get orange socks.
I never went there.
You can come in with me. I know where the cubbies are.
Okay. I might stay by my mom when we go in.
I found the blue tambourine under your booster seat. Want me to bring it when I meet you and Mom?
Yes please. I want to shake it when the choir gets loud.
Got it. Also put your scissors in the small bag, not the big one.
Ok. We are doing paper strips today with Ms. Ruth.
Are you coming after church? I get first turn with the red Lego roof.
Only if Uncle Dawit does not take the big table for cards.
My mom said Grandma wants to see your Elsa drawing again.
Mom has it on her phone too, the sparkly one.
We picked pajama day in class! I put my name card by the moon picture.
I put mine by extra recess but Mrs. Cole counted the cards and pajama day won.
My mom said grown-ups had papers in the mail too. Ours was more fun.
Yeah Mom said my paper was just the permission slip for the museum.
I packed your towel and goggles in the blue bag for after school.
Can I still wear my green shorts for Sunrise Sprouts on Saturday?
Yes. We will wash them tonight. Remember how Coach Ray asks you to check the numbers before the first kick.
I remember. I say five and five if there are ten.
Did your class pick the read-aloud for tomorrow, sweetheart?
The silly penguin book got more cubes in the cup than the space book.
Then we will practice being happy for the group choice. Remember what Dad and I said about taking turns and keeping everyone safe.
I told Aaliyah I can wait for my book next time.
My mom said maybe movie at your house after dinner. Can we have tablet turns too?
Yes. Mom said first we tell what happened at recess and put the art stuff away.
Ok. Can you do the Elsa song with the long note?
Only if you do the door part with me.
My little one, your mother sent me the sticker picture from the clinic. Did your arm feel better today?
It is better. I got two stickers because I sat still.
Good. When something is for keeping the family well, we listen to Mommy, Daddy, and the people at school who care for children.
Mom said I can see the family pictures on her phone after dinner, but I cannot go opening other places.
I put the blue base back by the small table. Your tall walls are still standing.
I found the baby bracelet in the file box. It only says PA and your birthday, no town printed.
Do not move the rainbow top. It is for the one with two windows.
Can I bring it for my class map?
Got it. Mom said there may be bowl duty after dinner if the counter is clear.
Bring a copy. Also Mom said your map pin goes near home first, and your family-story string can go across the ocean with Grandma's picture.
I will wash hands fast if I get to pour more chips.
Not to the table with the maracas stickers?
Mom said you had a big question during dinner. Want me to save the Lego roof piece for after pajamas?
Your soccer shin guards are in the hall bin. Want to help me build the blue Lego roof after dinner?
Yes. I asked why the people on TV were sad and Mom said some people get treated mean.
Yes. At school I got worried before reading to the class.
That's a good question. At school, you can be the kid who makes room in the game.
You still read the page, right? We can practice one page tonight and then do Lego cleanup together.
I heard you had a better recess today. Nice work.
I read it. My tummy stopped feeling twisty after I started.
I found that folded ship paper under the Lego box. Want it back in your nightstand?
I asked Ms. Rivera when I felt hot in my face.
Yes please. It has the room picture and the blue water.
And after that?
Aaliyah waved me over. Grace had chalk and Mateo kicked the ball too far.
Done. I put the ocean book beside it too, the one with the longer sentences.
And tell the teacher if someone keeps saying no.
I will do one page before story time.
Are you coming to the Y after school Friday? My mom said I can watch from the chairs.
Yes if I put my goggles back in the bag. Last time they were under my bed.
You should do the long side again. You almost made it.
I got tired near the flags. I want to get farther before the June group starts.
Your mama sent me the video with the little chairs. The bear looked very serious.
He was line leader but he forgot to raise his paw for the bathroom pass.
Next time show me the song with the hand motions, my sweet girl.
I will, and then the bunny gets a temperature check because she sneezed during the calendar page.
Selamawit sent the little video. You were holding the big cup with two hands.
It was cold and pink and I put the banana pieces in.
Good helper. Did you also finish the apple slices before church?
Yes. The carrots are for after dinner with the dip.
Send me photo of my sweet girl with the braids and beads today.
Mom took one by the food table. I said selam to Uncle first.
Good. Your white dress looked beautiful with the yellow stitching.
I liked when everyone clapped after the song.
I put the red cooler in the trunk. Do you want the green blanket or the flower one for Lakeview?
Flower one. And can we sit near the trees, not only the table?
Sure. Bring the little bag if you want to keep things you find.
I am bringing my fast shoes too.
I found your left cleat under the Lego bin. It is in the car now.
Thank you. Can we go to the tall blue bars after?
Yes. We will do field first, snack second, blue bars third.
I want to beat my time from the fence to the bench.
I put the cones by the garage. Want the red tape too?
Yes please. I need a start line and a finish line. Hana said she will race but she cannot jump before I say go.
Got it. I will watch the line and you can call the rounds.
And if Eli comes I will tell him the cone colors because he was not here last time.
Can we watch the funny cupcake video when you come over?
Maybe. I have to ask first.
My mom said after lunch if we do the Lego bin first.
Okay and I want the teacher game too.
Can Mekdes play Lego today after church?
Not today, honey. She is staying on the couch with her water and the blanket.
Can she watch Bluey and I will tell her the Lego plan later?
That is kind. Dad already checked the counter note and gave only what it said, so quiet shows are best for now.
Bring your mini figures Sunday. We can build the school again.
Okay but I can't ask for the big set yet. Mom put it on the birthday list.
Then use my pink blocks. Did you pick the thing for your trip pouch?
Not yet. Maybe ears, maybe Moana. I only have the folded money.
I put your museum permission slip in the blue folder. Please leave it there until we get to school.
Mekdes, the tablet is charged for the car ride. Reading game, math stars, or coloring only, please.
Can I take the dino drawing too?
Can I watch the cupcake video too?
One short kid video after math stars. If anything asks for a name or picture, hand it to me.
Yes, one drawing. The hallway hook is only for your jacket today, so don't hang the yarn tail there again.
Okay Mom. I will give it to you if that pops up.
Okay. It is for my pretend fox after school.
Mekdes, I found two birthday table covers: waves with flowers or pale blue with shiny flakes. We can only pick one today.
Waves if I can put the brave girl in the middle. But the cups can be blue.
That works. Please finish the thank-you picture before lunch, the one with all the kids together.
I will. Can the girl in the middle have curls and the red flower?
After church, please remind Grandma we need the woven basket back. The thin sour rounds stick if I stack them too early.
Can I carry the napkins with the candle colors?
Yes, just keep them clean. Auntie is bringing the chicken pot later, so we will put the kids' food on the side first.
I want to sit where I can hear the aunties talk.
Your mama showed me your drawing from the school visitor. You made the shiny lights very bright.
Did the little pig get the two shiny coins from my purse, sweet girl?
I also drew the parade one with candy.
Yes it made a loud plunk. Mommy said she will write the hard answers on the camp paper.
Good memory, my sweet girl. For the homework, you can say those are the times you have seen them close.
I asked Mommy and Daddy for names from our people, but we did not have one.
Good. You write your neat name and draw me a flower after.
When you come Saturday can we make a pretend office and stamp papers?
Yes but I want to be teacher first. I have stickers and a lunch chart.
My dad said the real forms on his desk are boring and not for us.
Mom said same. I only have spelling words and the soccer snack list.
Are you doing art club tomorrow? My mom said the teacher is Mr. Lee.
I don't know him.
You can show him the rainbow cat drawing first.
Maybe. I will stand with Mom until he says where to sit.
Did you get to clean the paint cups today or did Jayden do it?
I did cups and I was kind to him even when he splashed blue
Ms Carter said tomorrow bring the book with the green sticker.
I put it by my backpack so I remember
Coach moved the Sunrise Sprouts field to the one near the tennis courts tonight.
Is it still 6:15? How many minutes in the car? Do I need orange socks or blue?
Still 6:15. About 12 minutes. Blue socks, shin guards, water. I'll show you the map when I get home.
Can we put practice after dinner on my paper so it matches?
My sweet girl, did you show Mommy your reading page tonight?
Yes and I got the star game for a little bit.
Good. Brush, pajamas, then tell me tomorrow which story you picked.
Please put the library book beside your folder. The teacher also needs the class-party slip back today.
Can I take the gray-brown picture for show time?
Yes, the one from the DC day can go in the folder if it stays flat.
It has the big teeth, so I want Aaliyah to see it before swimming.
I saved the video Auntie Roman sent from Saturday. You can watch it after homework, okay? ❤️
Is it the one where Hana laughs and Grandma claps?
Yes. And Grandpa is waving near the kitchen door in the last part.
Can I show him my new animal picture next time?
My mom said I need my paper signed too. Did yours have a bandaid day?
Yes but I looked at Mom and not at the tiny needle.
I would close my eyes. My mom said ask Nurse Kelly tomorrow if we wonder about it.
Okay. I am not allowed to find kid body answers on Mom's phone by myself.
Your mama sent me your drawing with all the children holding hands. Tell me about it when we call.
It is the recess game where nobody gets left out.
Good heart. Did Mama help you with the hard TV talk again?
She said I only need the kid part: people should be safe and I can ask a grown-up.
My Mekdes, send Grandma a picture from school. Did you jump in hopscotch today?
I jumped to 10. I cried when Aaliyah picked tablet first but then we drew Moana.
Small tears can dry fast. I want to see your Moana drawing on video after dinner.
Okay. I can show you and then practice cartwheels with Dad.
Your mother sent the picture of your chart with stars. What did the class choose this week?
Game bins. I wanted extra recess but game bins had 12 and recess had 9.
Your mother sent me the little video from the church hall. You were standing with the children and pointing to the chairs.
Twelve is more. Good job accepting it, my sweet girl. At church we also practice letting others have a turn.
We played animal corners. I said little kids could pick corners after the big kids picked last time.

events.title: 10:30 family service + kids room
events.notes: Bring folder from last week, glue sticks, and the blue tambourine from the back seat.

events.title: School morning checklist
events.notes: Mom: folder and lunch. Dad: shoes by door, Lego bin before bus. Three smoothies if bananas are ripe.

events.title: Mekdes couch setup before school decision
events.notes: Thermometer, small marked cup, doctor printout on counter. Keep water bottle, honey tea, blue blanket, and PBS Kids remote nearby.

events.title: Folder, library book, shin guards
events.notes: Put folder in backpack, library book in front pocket, shin guards by the door. Check hamper before leaving.

events.title: Home after school
events.notes: Dinner first, reading folder page, 15 minutes on the iPad if the page is done, then tub and blue pajamas.

events.title: Mekdes yearly checkup + school activity form
events.notes: Bring swim/soccer form, immunization printout, nurse packet page with daily-items line left blank. Ask about getting nervous before first swim lesson.

events.title: Playground after school
events.location: Monroeville Community Park, upper play area
events.notes: Use upper gate by the picnic tables. Stay on the slide side while Mom finishes the snack bag; skip the lower path near the pickup lane if the lot is busy.

events.title: Giant Eagle curbside
events.notes: Add strawberries, bananas, apples, baby carrots, dip cups, cereal, peanut butter before checkout.

events.title: Pack for Sunrise Sprouts
events.notes: Set out shin guards, water bottle, and blue hair tie. Check coach email for field number, start whistle time, and pickup spot.

events.title: Move tooth-fairy dollars to Orlando pouch
events.notes: Check little notebook first: ears, ocean-princess toy, ice-princess item, or the big brick set.

events.title: 2nd grade bus to Smithsonian stop
events.location: 10th St & Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.notes: Wear blue class shirt. Bag lunch, water bottle, folder slip, and small sketch pad. Fossil hall page in backpack.

events.title: School safety guest in cafeteria
events.notes: Wear regular uniform. Bring blue folder home. Ask Grandma later about parade candy bag drawing.

events.title: Mekdes school form visit
events.notes: Bring blue folder paper. Ask Dr. Rosen to show the picture card first. Pack small Elsa sticker sheet for after the quick arm pinch.

events.title: Pack bag before practice
events.notes: Check blue towel, clear goggles, and the black shin guards before leaving.

events.title: Room 2: hand-count for Friday reward
events.notes: Choices listed on blue sheet: quiet game basket, extra playground time, pajama day. Send home the kindness page from this morning's helper story.

events.title: Ask Mekdes about recess card
events.notes: Prompt: who did you ask first today? Ms. Rivera / Aaliyah. Remember: say "Can I play?" before deciding what happened. Names from her story: Grace drawing, Mateo soccer.

events.title: Sunrise Sprouts practice
events.notes: Bring shin guards and water bottle. Ask Coach Ray if Mekdes can help count pinnies before teams start.

events.title: First soccer clinic check-in
events.notes: Arrive 10 minutes early. Bring shin guards and water. Stay with Mekdes at sign-in until Coach Riley calls groups.

events.title: Mekdes - field cones, goals, then park structure
events.notes: Pack cleats, shin pads, snack, and hair ties. Meet near the green slide after the field time.

events.title: Morning counter time + playroom mat
events.notes: Set out paper liners, bowl, whisk, mini chips. Clear den corner rug and leave sorted roof colors by the low shelf.

events.title: Library holds: reef animals + first chapter shelf
events.notes: Pick up the bright ocean book at the desk; let M choose one with fewer pictures if she wants to try.

events.title: Kitchen table: pink pig + blue folder
events.notes: Bring birthday envelope from dresser. Mom checks the blue folder pages before backpack.

events.title: Hana visit: rows, song card, checkup basket
events.notes: Set out blanket squares, name cards for bear/bunny/lion, toy microphone, thermometer, stickers, and snack timer.

events.title: Lunch after service
events.notes: Bring sketchpad and markers. Ask Mom to save phone battery for showing the princess-and-bunny page to anyone who misses lunch.

events.title: Hana visit - backyard games
events.notes: Chalk boxes, cones, jump rope. Mekdes wants name cards before starting so nobody asks 'when do I go?'

events.title: Tesfaye-Mahone family dinner
events.notes: Bring extra flat basket, lemon towels, kids' song list, and story cards. Adults asked for the spicy chicken dish separate from the mild lentils.

events.title: Kitchen table talk with Mom after the 6:00 segment
events.notes: Keep it short. Answer her questions in kid words. Remind her: get a grown-up at school, share the game, and speak up when someone is not being treated right.

events.title: Service, aunties' lunch, kids table
events.notes: Bring cupcakes, small speaker, card game, and extra wipes. Let Mekdes and Hana pick two songs after plates are cleared.

events.title: Target stop: party aisle and small toy shelf
events.notes: Compare ocean-wave plates with blue snowflake cups. Bring the crayon page from the fridge to match colors. Check for little canoe girl or snow-braid figure under $18.

events.title: Lakeview State Park - blanket, sandwiches, fruit cups
events.notes: Pack wipes, small ball, blue jacket, and a grocery bag for anything Mekdes wants to carry home.

events.title: After-church family lunch
events.notes: Pack Mekdes's white dress with the stitched hem, green-yellow-red hair beads, drawing folder for Grandma, and practice saying selam before dessert.

events.title: Bedroom reset before school week
events.notes: Library book in backpack, shin guards by door, stuffed snowman off floor, no water bowl or leash hook to move.

events.title: School form: copy baby papers for Mrs. Nolan
events.notes: Find hospital keepsake envelope; write PA for birthplace line if city is still unclear. Attach family recipe photo for heritage board, not the Spanish-song group sheet.

events.title: Mekdes tablet turn
events.notes: Unlock Kids folder after spelling sheet. Reading app first, then 5 minutes coloring if timer is still green. Send finished picture to Grandma from Mom's phone.

events.title: Backpack check + bus stop
events.notes: Folder, lunch, library book, reading log. Leave the county envelopes on kitchen desk for Selamawit and Daniel.

events.title: Mekdes backpack check
events.notes: Library book, purple folder, snack card, sneakers. Ask Mrs. Keller: assembly before math? how many songs? who sits with our table?

events.title: First Wednesday swim block
events.notes: Bring goggles, towel, dry socks. Folder has June class picnic sheet and thank-you drawing for the DC chaperone.

events.title: Reading log and table forks
events.notes: Read two pages aloud, sign the sheet, set forks for dinner, then put library book back in backpack.

events.title: Thursday dinner and cleanup
events.notes: Set three plates. Dad reads one chapter after dishes. Put guest blanket back in hall closet.

events.title: Saturday dinner at Auntie Roman's
events.notes: Pack crayons, blue folder, and charger. Let Almaz see the kindness drawing before dessert; send a photo to Uncle Dawit if he leaves early.

events.title: Quick yard time before dinner
events.notes: Bring ball and chalk. End when porch light comes on; Dad stays by the steps while Mekdes uses the scooter loop.

events.title: Palm branch project + youth choir morning
events.notes: Hana may sit with Mekdes for the kids table. Pack crayons, safety scissors, and snack money for the collection basket.

events.title: Backpack card
events.notes: Tiny note for lunchbox: Ms. Rivera first if the blacktop gets confusing. Then use words with Aaliyah: "Can I play?" Ask Grace about markers; ask Mateo about the ball.

events.title: Turn in class map board
events.notes: Board pieces: PA baby-paper copy, question mark for city, Grandma's Addis photo, airplane drawing marked someday, injera recipe card. Do not forget to return unused music-table stickers.

events.title: School culture night table
events.notes: Bring injera rolls, coffee-pot photo from Grandma, Mekdes's white embroidered dress, green-yellow-red beads, and small card with selam written large.

events.title: Little Swimmers registration reminder
events.notes: Pick June morning slot. Add towel and goggles to supply list; keep shin guards out for the earlier field practice.

events.title: Saturday pages + blue-water jar
events.notes: Read 3 pages from the Australia ocean book; add sticker to the jar after chores.

events.title: Saturday errands with Dad
events.notes: Return Moana book, choose cupcake liners, pick up AA batteries for nightlight. Skip food aisle with bird seed and litter.

events.title: Family photo sorting and practice songs
events.notes: Choose phone videos from last winter candle night and September flower dinner. Prep mild stew for kids, red chicken bowl for adults, and extra sour flatbread for the serving tray.

events.title: Hana visit - cones, goal net, park bars
events.notes: Bring small ball, water, chalk for start line, and wipes for hands after the bars.

events.title: Quiet couch night
events.notes: Honey tea cooled first, extra blanket from hallway closet, water bottle refilled. Daniel picks one movie everyone can sit through; Selamawit keeps thermometer and marked cup out of reach.

events.title: Empty backpack pocket before bed
events.notes: Put loose change in pink pig. Leave sealed white envelope and long form on Mom and Dad's desk.

events.title: Kitchen table paperwork
events.notes: Parents finish household forms after dinner. Mekdes: math sheet, reading log, choose Friday classroom reward picture.
